# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 21 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 21 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_021_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 21

**21:1** When Herod realized that the Magi had deceived him, he fell into a rage and dispatched executioners with the order: "Put to death all the male children two years old and younger."

**21:2** Mary heard that children were being killed. In her fear, she wrapped the infant in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger.

**21:3** Elizabeth too heard that John was being sought. She took him and fled into the hill country. She searched for somewhere to hide him and found nothing. Then Elizabeth cried out in distress: "O mountain of God, receive a mother and her child!" For Elizabeth was unable to climb any further. And immediately the mountain split open and took them in. And a light shone through the mountain to guide her, for an angel of the Lord was with them, keeping them safe.
